title: The Great and Powerful Genie
description: A fantasy-romance vertical series built around a genie who upends a mortal's ordinary life with wishes, magic, and complications neither of them planned for.
descriptionMore: A wish-granting genie is pulled into a mortal woman's ordinary life, and neither of them stays the same once his magic starts rewriting the rules around them. Told across 51 vertical, bite-sized episodes, the series leans into the genre's signature mix of fantasy spectacle and slow-burn romance.
